name: Shooting Gallery: Range and Cover
read_aloud: Behind the far counter, mannequins in staff polos turn their heads all at once, with a sound like a dropped tray of silverware. Each one raises a pink plastic bow that is very clearly not a toy. Somewhere above, Proctor Bell suggests getting behind things.
narrator_line: Behind the far counter, mannequins in staff polos turn their heads all at once, with a sound like a dropped tray of silverware.
layout: A carnival shooting gallery scaled up to a big room: plywood cutouts on squeaking conveyors, overturned counters, sandbags, a cash register on a stool, and mannequins in staff polos behind the far counter.

exits.name: Back to the Hall of Fair Warnings (Z4).
A door with a cartoon coffee cup on it: the Break Room (Z6).

features.name: Counters and sandbags (half cover); the brick prize booth (three-quarters cover).
Conveyors carry a standing Crawler 10 ft at the end of each round (00-overview.md section 5.5).
The mannequins shoot from behind the far counter and close to melee only if the Crawlers do.

enemies.note: spoken_name is the live Day-page name. stat_card is the SRD body in this pack. Dean Thudd is not renamed.

quick_run.setup: A carnival shooting gallery where smiling mannequins shoot from behind counters.
quick_run.decision: Use cover and close carefully, or rush the counter?
quick_run.on_success: The mannequins fall, the cover lesson lands and the register pays out.
quick_run.on_failure: Crawlers caught in the open take the shots; someone needs a short-rest slot in the Break Room.
quick_run.cut_short: Run two rounds with cover, then resolve the rest as one group check.

loot.text: Cash register: credits and a raffle ticket that does nothing (00-overview.md section 5.5).

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
